project.name: bee-epic-apiary
project.description: Monorepo e-commerce platform for an apiary (honey/beeswax) business: shared types, Cloudflare Worker backend, React admin panel, React PWA storefront.

shared.name: @bee-epic/shared
shared.role: Canonical TypeScript types + Zod schemas shared across all packages.

files.description: API envelope IApiResponse<T>, discriminated IApiError, ApiResponseSchema(), upstream error type.
User/invite/reset/refresh-family/auth-policy schemas + TTL constants; toUserPublic().
Email body/format types and template data shapes (order, comm).
Barrel re-exporting all shared type modules.
Notification event discriminated union (new-order/status-changed/product-updated/deleted).

Order schema/types incl. shipping, fulfillment status, line items, update payloads. Client OrderUpdateSchema.metadata now carries the same order_status enum refinement as server OrderUpdateRequestSchema (client/server parity).

Product Zod schema/types (IProduct, IProductInput, IProductUpdateRequest, EProductCategory). default_price validated with an anchored /^price_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/ regex (rejects bare prefix + embedded-newline bypass).
Site content, category, nav link, social, process step, testimonial schemas; ESettingsType.
Staff role enum, role rank map, roleSatisfies() authority check.
Stripe API response shapes (price, product, product list).

services.name: bee-epic-apiary-services
services.role: Cloudflare Worker: Stripe checkout/CRUD, auth, settings, contact email, SSE notifications, rate limiting.

files.description: POST /contact: routes to Formspark or Cloudflare Email.
Worker entry: default fetch handler + Durable Object exports (NotificationHub, RateLimiterDO).

NotificationHub Durable Object: SQLite-backed SSE fanout with replay window + eviction. heartbeat()/broadcast() iterate a snapshot of the connection set and delete-in-place on failed write, so a concurrent fetch() subscribe is never lost to a set swap.
Manual request router; exact-path matching, per-route method + role gating.
GET|PUT /settings/:type (site|process|testimonials|categories).
POST /checkout: splits recurring + one-time Stripe sessions.
Confirms an order from a completed checkout session; sends notification + email.

POST /stripe/webhook: signature-verified, idempotent checkout.session.completed -> confirmOrder. Idempotency key is RESERVED in CONTENT_KV before dispatch and released (deleted) on confirmOrder failure, closing the concurrent-duplicate window while staying retryable.
Resolve client IP as a guaranteed string: cf.connectingIp -> CF-Connecting-IP header -> 'unknown'. Centralises a coercion that workerd's over-wide cf typing otherwise breaks.
Origin allow-list check: compares full URL origin (scheme+host+port), not just hostname, so http:// downgrades and arbitrary ports are rejected.
RateLimiterDO Durable Object + pure checkRateLimit() logic.
RateLimiter client for the DO; fail-open on DO error.
Three-path auth chain: cookie JWT -> bearer API key -> dev X-Dev-Email header.
Middleware: CORS, method check, origin allow-list, auth resolution, write-floor, rate limit, try/catch.
Middleware injecting memoised Stripe client + Stripe error mapping; delegates to withAuthHandler.

admin.name: bee-epic-apiary-admin
admin.role: React 19 admin SPA: manage products, orders, users, settings; cookie auth.

files.description: Axios API client (envelope unwrap, typed ApiError, coalesced 401-refresh). updateProduct creates the new Price first, then applies metadata + default_price in a single PUT (atomic — no orphaned price-then-failed-update window).

web.name: bee-epic-apiary-web
web.role: Public React 19 PWA storefront: catalog, cart, Stripe checkout, SEO.

files.description: Storefront top nav + cart button. Count badge is aria-hidden; a polite sr-only aria-live region announces the cart item total to screen readers.
Slide-in cart dialog. Uses useFocusTrap for accessible Tab-trapping, Escape-to-close, and focus restoration to the trigger on close.
Single cart line row. Thumbnail has explicit width/height + loading=lazy to curb layout shift.
Product grid card. Image has explicit width/height + loading=lazy to curb layout shift and defer offscreen loads.
Reusable accessible-dialog hook: traps Tab/Shift+Tab within a container, closes on Escape via onClose, and restores focus to the previously focused element on cleanup. Returns the container ref.
